---
title: "MOUS Group Report"
format: html
params:
  summary_json: "derivatives/mous_pipeline/group_summary.json"
---

```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

summary = json.loads(Path(params["summary_json"]).read_text())
rows = []
for metric, stats in summary.get("metrics", {}).items():
    rec = {"metric": metric}
    rec.update(stats)
    rows.append(rec)
tbl = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

## Group summary table

```{python}
tbl
```

## Group means by metric

```{r}
df <- as.data.frame(tbl)
if ("mean" %in% names(df)) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = metric, y = mean)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Group mean by metric", x = "Metric", y = "Mean")
}
```
